source.name: cresci2017_pilot
source.citation: Cresci et al. The paradigm-shift of social spambots. WWW Companion 2017; Cresci et al. Fame for sale. Decision Support Systems 2015.
source.license: Research purposes only; original DATA_LICENSE.txt retained
source.group_definition: Original archive collection category, not independently verified campaigns
source.limitations: Bounded pilot, not full benchmark. First available tweets per selected account in archive order; snapshot timing unverified, so chronological evaluation unsupported. Cresci-2015 and Cresci-2017 share underlying accounts/collections; transfer is a sensitivity analysis, not independent external validation.

target.name: gilani-2017_snapshots
target.license: Bot Repository academic research use; see https://botometer.osome.iu.edu/bot-repository/datasets.html
target.citation: Gilani et al. Of bots and humans (on Twitter). ASONAM 2017.
target.limitations: Only user snapshots and a record timestamp are supplied. No tweet IDs, objects or event histories; temporal and graph transfer is unsupported. No campaign annotations.

feature_mapping: Same canonical numeric profile fields; same rhythm and shared-object definitions. Missing target fields use source-fitted imputer.
limitation: Dataset-specific annotation and collection differences confound transfer; inspect feature missingness audits
